patthana24.21:1.1: dhammaṃ paṭicca saraṇo sārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. ekaṃ.
patthana24.21:2.1: na saraṇaṃ na anārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca araṇo anārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā dve.
patthana24.21:3.1: na saraṇaṃ na cittaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca araṇo citto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā dve (saṃkhittaṃ.)
patthana24.21:4.1: na saraṇaṃ na cetasikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca araṇo cetasiko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā dve.
patthana24.21:5.1: na saraṇaṃ na citta sampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca araṇo cittasampayutto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. dve.
patthana24.21:6.1: na saraṇaṃ na cittasaṃsaṭṭhaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca araṇo cittasaṃsaṭṭho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā dve. …pe… na araṇaṃ na dassanena
